title: ENC encoder daughterboard - board_gen pipeline pilot
note: Pipeline pilot of pcb/board_gen.py (W2 PCB-PIPE). PCB-SB1 replaces the J1 placeholder with the GR-3 ENC-side header ref and makes the final board; nothing here is a fabrication release.

layers.source: PCB-SB1 plan: ENC is a 2-layer 1.6 mm 1 oz board (final-plan.json PCB-SB1 brief); the 4-layer default of build/15 'Шари' is for the main boards

plan.B.Cu: scripted GND link, signals, GND pour

rules_note: Pilot rules live in the committed ENC.kicad_pro (project choice above the fab floor: track 0.25 / clearance 0.2, minimum 0.15 / 0.15, via 0.6 / 0.3, copper-edge 0.3, hole-hole 0.5, hole clearance 0.25, text 1.0 / 0.15). PCB-RULES adds pcb/rules/*.kicad_dru; PCB-SB1 points rules_file at it.

fab_floor.min_hole_to_hole_note: 0.45 = pad hole-to-hole of different nets; via hole-to-hole is 0.2

list.source: tools/assembly_data.py:133 unit ENCM = ENC301 + SW308 at place_at main; the ENC1 role is still 'звірити' until GR-1 (R-E3-16)
tools/assembly_data.py:135 unit ENCV = ENC302 + SW309 at place_at volume

parts.anchor_source: contract encoder_at [12, 12] (mechanical/params/boards.json:162); MP slot centre = shaft axis (footprint descr); rotation 90 keeps the left strip x 0-4.5 free

parts.footprint_sha256_source: https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-footprints/-/raw/10.0.7/Connector_PinHeader_2.00mm.pretty/PinHeader_1x04_P2.00mm_Vertical.kicad_mod read 2026-11-07; checked against the kicad/kicad:10.0.7 image copy at run time
parts.pins_source: build/16-dzhgut-rozyemy.csv:60 and :62 (X37S1-ENCM / X38S1-ENCV: PH 4, pins GND, A, B, PRESS; synthesized, not a graph ref)
parts.replaced_by: GR-3 ENC-side header ref (graph), then PCB-SB1
parts.why_placeholder: No JST PH housing fits beside the PEC11R on the 24 x 24 outline: the S4B-PH-K side-entry body is 7.6 mm deep and the B4B-PH-K vertical courtyard 5.5 mm wide, while the strip between the left edge and the PEC11R courtyard is 4.5 mm (encoder at 90 deg) and a vertical PH is 8 mm tall against the 6.5 mm envelope (tools/assembly_data.py:120-121). The pilot keeps a 2.0 mm 4-pad land in the contract edge zone left [6, 18]; the header choice stays with GR-3/PCB-SB1/MECH-4.

tracks.why: scripted locked copper: return link J1.1 to the encoder common C; also the DSN/SES lock probe

height_zones.why: footprints carry no body heights; the enclosure height check belongs to the mechanical model (fit-report)

warning_checks.footprint_filters_mismatch: schematic-parity check; per-board PCBs are not linked to the multi-sheet schematic, so DRC runs without --schematic-parity and the source-pad audit replaces it
warning_checks.missing_tuning_profile: no length-tuned nets and no tuning profiles on this board
warning_checks.tuning_profile_track_geometries: no length-tuned nets and no tuning profiles on this board
warning_checks.generic_warning: KiCad's catch-all warning class; any instance is listed in report.json and reviewed
warning_checks.silk_over_copper: legend only: the fab clips legend over exposed copper; the vendored PEC11R outline (tools/make_footprints.py) crosses its own A/C/B pads
warning_checks.silk_overlap: legend only: overlapping legend items are cosmetic; every instance is listed in report.json
